label: Watch Climate Bridge
info:
Bridges the esp32c6-watch <-> HA climate.* entities over MQTT.
Watch subscribes: watch/climate/<object_id>/state (retained JSON, HA-native strings)
Watch publishes: watch/climate/<object_id>/set  ({"set":72} or {"mode":"heat"})
The command node is capability-aware: it translates auto<->heat_cool to whatever
each device actually supports (Nest = heat_cool-only, minisplits = auto).
WIRE ENCODING = HA-native strings (mode/action/modes); the watch's crates/climate-model
maps them to its internal enum/int for the UI. See ha-bridge/README.md.
